title: Boring on a bushing with outside features reports false rest

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
Found during #2865. Related catalog work: #2392.

Base: upstream/main `58cb641ca`.

Use original closed meshes. Revolve each listed `(radius, Z)` meridian about Z with 48 angular segments.
Use `assets/machines/lathe.mch` and the `Fanuc Lathe` post.
Import the blank as stock with `set_stock {from_model: ...}`.
Set `set_raw_stock_only {on: true}`. Keep all verification checks active.

## What happens

Boring finishes the upper internal wall of a bushing. The outside model has a chamfer, neck, form groove and taper.
Generation succeeds. Verification blocks the post:

```text
finish envelope near move 1: 0.0000 mm gouge, 11.5425 mm rest
```

## Reproduce

Use this finished meridian. Define `c(d) = 14 - sqrt(36 - d*d)`.

```text
(0,0), (8,0), (10,2), (10,12), (9,12), (9,20), (10,20),
(10,28), (c(2),28), (c(1),29), (8,30), (c(1),31),
(c(2),32), (10,32), (10,40), (8,60), (6,60), (6,20), (0,20)
```

Use this blank meridian:

```text
(0,0), (10,0), (10,40), (8,60), (5.6,60), (5.6,20), (0,20)
```

Create Boring as the first operation. Use `BR-1000` and the finished model as source.
Use fixed heights: clearance 70, top 58, bottom 42.
Use tolerance 0.05, feed 120 and plunge feed 40.
Generate, then call `verify`.

The pilot diameter is 11.2 mm. It clears the 10 mm boring bar.
The model wall has radius 6 throughout the operation window.

## Expected result

Judge the internal wall in the stated window. Outside features must not create rest that this boring pass cannot remove.

## Passing comparison

A plain bored cylinder passes with the same operation parameters.
Its meridian is `(0,0),(10,0),(10,60),(6,60),(6,20),(0,20)`.
The blank has the same outside shape and a radius 5.6 pilot hole.

A bushing with the form groove but no outside chamfer, neck or taper also verifies and posts.
Both comparisons keep tolerance 0.05 and 48 angular segments.

The evidence does not isolate which outside feature triggers the refusal.
Related issue #2880 concerns Profile Finish, not this internal Boring operation.

Effort: high. The fix changes a verification rule and has the safety floor.

Done means: A test reproduces this refusal. The valid operation verifies and posts. Real gouges and unfinished promised surfaces still block posting.
